reviews.title: Great deal great mouse
reviews.comment: I can’t tell the difference between brand new and refurbished. Excellent quality, packaging was simple, mouse works incredibly well, battery lasts for weeks without charging and it has an auto shut off when not in use!

reviews.title: Perfect with caveats
reviews.comment: This product is for bro. Why is it for bro? Because it's basically a brand new Superlight 2 for 50-80$ less than msrp. There's no scuffs on it. The pads were fine, but I replaced them anyway. This mouse has an issue with the battery adhesive whether you buy it brand new or used. In my case, the battery was loose and rattling around. When I replaced the pads, I used super glue to stick it in place, I just looked it up on youtube and watched a short. It was easy, refer to the picture for where to position it, and no more rattling. The battery life is d a n k. Purchase this.
reviews.author: Peetey

reviews.title: Faulty parts
reviews.comment: DO NOT BUY!!!! I had bought this because it says excellent condition but that was not the case. The mouse skates were all scratched up, didn't come with a box, was missing all the grip tape that usually comes with the mouse, and to top it all off the mouse only works wired. It will not connect to the dongle that comes with it and yes I tried updating both the mouse and dongle and pairing the two via Ghub and it still doesnt connect unless im wired.
reviews.author: marc

reviews.title: Top-tier device with a minor issue
reviews.comment: I've been using this mouse for a while now -technically it's perfect, the sensor and weight are spot on. Unfortunately, it arrived without the included grip stickers. It's a bummer since I was looking forward to using them. Otherwise, highly recommended
